offering_description.value: Federal Signal manufactures specialty vehicles and equipment for municipalities, contractors and industrial operators. It also makes warning and signaling systems for emergency responders, communities and industrial facilities, and provides equipment rental, maintenance and repair.

primary_products.value: street sweepers and sewer cleaners; vacuum excavation trucks; refuse collection trucks; dump truck bodies and trailers; emergency vehicle and industrial warning systems

primary_services.value: specialty equipment rental; equipment maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2G: Municipal public works and sanitation departments, transportation agencies, police and fire departments; B2B: Utility and excavation contractors, waste haulers, construction companies, industrial plants and commercial fleets

end_markets.value: municipal infrastructure maintenance; waste collection; construction and utilities; industrial operations; public safety

revenue_model.value: product sales: Specialty vehicles, truck bodies, replacement parts and warning systems; rental or leasing: Rental of sweepers, sewer cleaners and vacuum excavation equipment; service fees: Maintenance and repair of specialty vehicles and equipment
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds specialty vehicles and warning systems from chassis and components for public agencies, contractors and industrial operators; distributor: Supplies specialty equipment and replacement parts to fleet operators and contractors; service provider: Rents and repairs specialty equipment for municipalities, contractors and industrial operators

geography_served.value: global: United States and Canada, with sales in Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: Environmental and infrastructure equipment, plus emergency vehicle and industrial warning systems

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent specialty equipment dealers and warning-system distributors; direct sales: Sales teams serving public agencies, contractors, fleets and industrial customers; own locations: Company-operated equipment sales, rental and service centers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Vehicle and equipment manufacturing is subject to applicable federal motor vehicle safety, emissions and workplace safety standards.
